dedupe_keys.name: sweetpo sweet potato production simulation model version 2 1 international potato center

description: SWEETPO is a user-friendly crop growth model from the International Potato Center that simulates dry mass accumulation of different sweet potato varieties, with daily increments in storage roots and total biomass under potential growth conditions. The CIP Dataverse page gives version 2.1 as a setup archive of about 8.2 MB and a documentation PDF of about 15 MB, with authors Carla Gavilan, Bruno Condori, Carolina Barreda, Roberto Quiroz, Jose Guerrero, Mariana Cruz, Johan Ninanya, Javier Rinza and David Ramirez. It was issued in 2017, with the current dataset version 3 released on 21 March 2020, downloadable and free under CC0 1.0. Coverage is any sweet potato growing site with weather inputs. Caveats: the page says it simulates potential growth only, so water and nutrient limits are not modelled, and the platform requirements are in the documentation, not on the page read. For simulation it gives baseline sweet potato yields for climate and food security scenarios. Related catalogue records include SOLANUM, DSSAT and APSIM.
